decisions.reason: The authentication service was upgraded to its own page in 2024, which signals growing public commitment and integration into the firm's announced enterprise-integration direction, so management will persist with it.

The open GIS framework embodies the firm's stated strategy of open, extensible components and reflects substantial development investment, so despite modest visibility management will keep it and attribute slow uptake to temporary factors.
The identity and access service for GIS applications gained its own page in 2024 and fits the core geospatial-plus-enterprise direction, making a reversal hard to justify.
The consulting workshop is newly launched with a dedicated page, builds on established know-how and certified trainers at low cost, and is too recent for disappointing results to be judged.
